colorRoles.$comment: Semantic aliases each surface's Tailwind config should map to the raw palette above.

colorStrategy.website: committed — forest.600 carries 30-60% of surface area (section backgrounds), not just accents
colorStrategy.adminDashboard: restrained — neutrals dominate, forest.600 only as the single actionable accent

display.usage: website headlines only — never dashboard/app UI
display.face: Archivo Expanded/Black (or equivalent bold geometric sans with architectural weight)
display.rationale: avoids Fraunces/Playfair/Space Grotesk/Syne and other default AI-brand display faces

body.face: Inter (or each surface's existing workhorse grotesk)

typography.scale: standard 1.25 modular scale for dashboards/app; website may break scale deliberately at the first-viewport headline

motif.name: geometric relief
motif.description: stacked triangle/lozenge units per brand/logo-mark.svg construction, used as section dividers, empty-state illustrations, and skeleton/loading states — never as full background texture or literal building photography
motif.usage: sparingly — a signature accent, not wallpaper

logo.status: delivered - real mark (forest green on transparent) shipped across vendor dashboard, customer app/website, and admin placeholder (2026-09-07)
